WHY WEB3 CARNIVAL

Innovation belongs to everyone.

The organisers describe Web3 Carnival as a place for blockchain ideas, industry leaders and newcomers to meet through conferences, side events and cultural exchange. Its vision centres on an inclusive Web3 community, with a specific mission to empower women and help startups grow.

InnovationInclusivityCollaborationEmpowerment

From the original About page ↗ and Why Carnival page ↗.

BEHIND THE GATHERING

Partners make room for more.

The original website groups its historical supporters as sponsors, venture capital partners, a crypto payment partner, ticketing partners, community partners and media partners. The sponsorship page also describes exhibition and branding opportunities.

Past sponsors

Brinc, Soulverse, Outdefine, Versatile, Bounce, SafeVerse and Casa NFT are among the visible marks.

Crypto payment

CopperX is listed as the crypto payment partner.

Ticketing

Paytm Insider and Explara are listed as ticketing partners.

Community and media

Dozens of groups and publications are shown in the original partner galleries.
